gen-fs-khand-fs-neco: Neco is a text serif with a gentle swell from hairline to stem, dignified and never pinched. Khand above it is crisp and tightly spaced, every stroke the same weight from stem to terminal, which makes the pair's difference obvious.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Almendra Display carries an ornate, literary air, its letters never pinching shut. Noto Sans Nushu is a plain sans with towering lowercase and terminals held far from the stroke, so its modern look is the strongest single quality here.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Audiowide looks like futuristic tiles, each stroke a drawn cable. Noto Sans Ogham, a plain sans, runs on with wide gaps in its e and tall bodies that look bold, so a long stretch feels dense yet clean.
gen-fredoka-lora: Lora brings a bookish serif voice, with modest hairline thinning at the curves and a broad, welcoming c, under Fredoka's friendly line. Fredoka holds one width everywhere, so the two feel soft together.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-ol-chi: Ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut give Almendra Display its pronounced, storybook presence over the page. Noto Sans Ol Chiki, a clean sans, can be sized freely.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Tile-like and futuristic, Audiowide has no hairlines anywhere, and Noto Sans Old Hungarian answers with large open counters in a, e and s. Its apertures stay open even at tiny sizes.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-it: Almendra Display wears its ornate, literary character in letters that never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. It earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Old Italic stays out of its way.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Noto Sans Old North Arabian is dense and tall, with outward-pointing terminals. Under Audiowide's tech-minded headings, a longer passage would feel approachable and compact, never fussy or loud.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-pe: Noto Sans Old Permic is rounded and approachable, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Almendra Display does ornate, literary showmanship best, while this sans-serif simply stays open and legible.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-so: Almendra Display has an ornate, literary look, and Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows with a tall x-height that nearly reaches cap height. A longer passage would read clean and approachable.
